goal: A Review dispatch aimed at a pending reservation by its operation marker is blocked before the reviewer runs when its reviewer type or, on Pi, its Agent parameters differ from the reservation, on both Hosts, and a reservation that never bound a reviewer is released when its Review is submitted, with a recovery that requests a fresh Review, instead of an indefinite wait (Spec review-dispatch-handle S1, D1-D4, D7, D8).

acceptance.assertion: On Pi, the reserved prompt starts with the marker `<!-- immune-brain:operation_id=<op> task_id=<task> -->`. A dispatch carrying a pending marker is blocked, binding nothing, with a reason naming each differing field, for each of: `subagent_type` `general-purpose`; the prompt with one appended character; `run_in_background` omitted or `true`; `isolated` omitted or `false`; `max_turns` different from the reserved value; `inherit_context` `true`. A dispatch whose marker names a released or unknown operation is blocked with a reason naming `advance_assurance`. A second dispatch after a bound one is blocked and the first binding still settles. A `Review` dispatch without a marker while a reservation is pending stays blocked, and a marker-less `general-purpose` dispatch is not blocked. A differing `description` alone does not block.

On Claude, a `PreToolUse` payload for `Agent` whose `tool_input.prompt` carries a marker and whose `tool_input.subagent_type` is `general-purpose` or absent returns a deny decision naming `subagent_type`; the same prompt with `immune-brain:immune-brain-reviewer` or `immune-brain-reviewer`, and a marker-less `general-purpose` dispatch, return no decision.

`submit_review` on a reservation with no bound reviewer releases it with `RELEASED_REVIEW_RECOVERY`, and the next `advance_assurance` returns a reservation with a new operation id and an unchanged turn budget, on both Hosts. Covered unbound cases: nothing dispatched; on Pi a blocked dispatch; on Claude a reserved prompt whose only bound event is `PostToolUse` (no reviewer `SubagentStart`), an edited prompt, missing host state for the reservation, and no reservation for the task. A bound reviewer whose result has not returned still returns `RETAINED_REVIEW_RECOVERY`, and an unbound release records no incomplete round.

ADR 0030 records the marker-keyed dispatch check, the per-Host enforced fields and the release-on-unbound rule, and marks ADR 0017's verbatim reserved-prompt rule and Spec branch-boundary-r2-followups D2 superseded; ADR 0017 carries `partially superseded`; the Loop contract states that a non-matching dispatch is blocked at dispatch and an unbound reservation is released, and no longer says an edit forfeits the reservation.
Packaged dist docs and role prompts match their canonical sources.
The generated Claude MCP bundle and reviewer definition match the runtime source.

scope_size_reason: Settlement-class: both Hosts' Review binding, the Claude hook route, mediation and the coordinator release owner are one reservation state machine, and the shared dual-host invariant fails if either Host changes alone.
